transcript: Life is going to work out perfectly for you. All the right things are going to happen. All the right people will enter your life, and all the wrong ones will quietly leave. You will live in a beautiful home. You will have work that fills you with purpose, and you will wake up every morning next to the love of your life. You will have peaceful mornings, slow Sundays, and gentle holidays. You will travel the world. You will meet souls who help you, and souls you will help in ways you could never have imagined. You will be recognized not just for what you achieve, but for the light you bring to others. So, please, stop worrying. Everything is already unfolding as it should. Your life is going to work out perfectly. Read these words each morning when you rise, and each night before you rest, and you'll begin to see how peace changes everything.
